description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Handling' for the 'Handling' total extension in an OpenCart admin module. It manages the display and saving of configuration settings for handling fees within the admin interface.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: A controller class for managing the handling total extension settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the handling total extension, setting up breadcrumbs, retrieving configuration values, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updated settings for the handling total extension, including permission checks and JSON response.
